target: finite auxiliary-ratio existence boundary with nonzero logistic signal and a free intercept
data: independent simulated Gaussian covariates, Bernoulli logit choices and a flipped-choice proxy; no new respondent or LLM responses
positive_powers: tau/(1+tau), a comparator weight rather than a claim of nonnull optimality
population_checks: gamma=0 recovers the previous null formula
separate zero-power endpoint equals the classical ordinary-logit scalar formula
retain: all feasible, exterior and unresolved statuses; no success-only denominator; no adaptive stopping
novelty: generic statistical dimension, Gaussian random-nullspace results and ordinary-logit endpoint are prior work
claim_scope: finite-ratio Gaussian slopes with one logistic signal and estimated intercept; not a categorical-DCE sample-size rule or CI guarantee
